packageRules.description: eve 0.33 dropped hook contracts 1-9 (model identity moved from session.started to step.started call attribution) and supports only 10. @upstash/agentkit-eve-extension@0.4.0 is the latest release and still declares hook: 1, so 0.33 fails `eve build`. Drop this rule once Upstash publishes an extension built against hook contract 10.
